MANAGING DIRECTOR, GILGIT-BALTISTAN POWER
MANAGING DIRECTOR, GILGIT-BALTISTAN POWER
DEVELOPMENT BOARD (APPOINTMENT)
RULES, 2013
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part II,
10th July, 2013]
S.R.O.
652(I)/2013, dated 9-7-2013.--In pursuance of section 4 of Gilgit-Baltistan
Power Development Board Act, 2012, the following method, qualification and
other conditions are laid down for appointment to the post of Managing Director
(MP-I), Gilgit-Baltistan Power Development Board namely:--
1. Short
title and Commencement:--
(a) These
rules may be called the Managing Director, Gilgit-Baltistan Power Development
Board (Appointment) Rules, 2013.
(b) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Method
of appointment:--
The method of appointment to the post of Managing
Director shall be appointment on contract basis for an expert from the market
failing which by transfer or deputation. His salary and other allowances would
be as admissible from time to time in Management Position (MP-I). A civil
servant may be taken on deputation and in case of deputation pay and allowances
of the parent department plus deputation allowance will be admissible.
3. Qualification,
Experience and Age Limit:--
Minimum
age limit 45 and maximum age limit 55 years, B.Sc (Engineering) in Civil or
Mechanical or Electrical having registered with Pakistan Engineering Council
(PEC), MBA (Finance) from a recognized University would be an added advantage.
Should have overall experience of at least 20 years of which 7 Years experience
of dealing with Federal or Provincial Power Generation Policy / Power Sector.
Should be well conversant with the implementation of Power Projects on BOOT,
BOO & BOT etc. He should have experience and be familiar with developing
documents like POD, RFP, PPA and IA and their legal and financial implications.
Should have experience of examining and reviewing of feasibility studies of
Power Projects and Tariff issues. Should possess experience of planning and scheduling
of large scale projects.

Development Board (GBPDB) which acts as one stop organization for private
investors on behalf of all the Departments and Agencies of Gilgit-Baltistan
Region in matter relating to the setting up of Power Projects under
Gilgit-Baltistan Power Generation Policy.

ii. Encourage and
ensure exploitation of indigenous resources (Hydel/Oil Coal Biomass/Solar)
for development of thermal or Hydel Power projects in the Gilgit-Baltistan
through private sector participation. iii. Negotiate and finalize with
prospective developers, the implementtation plans, feasibility studies and
operational plans. iv. Receive fees and charges from private power developers
in the processing of their applications and to deposite and disburse the
same. v. Open and operate bank accounts in local and foreign currencies. vi.
Correspond with concerned local and international agencies except in matters
involving commitment of the Government of Pakistan. vii. Process issuance of
NOC, LOI and LOS regarding use of canal/river water and land for power
generation. viii. Co-ordinate with federal Govermment/ WAPDA for installation
of Power Houses, Grids and Transmission Lines according to needs of the
Gilgit-Baltistan. ix. Take up all matters as may be required to promote power
generation in the Gilgit-Baltistan. x. Any other matters incidental to the
implementation of Policy for Power generation or as may be assigned by the
GBPDB.
